curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.subStrand: Yes/ No questions (with can, may, will)
curriculum.outcomeText: identify Yes/No questions with can, may, and will from a text

mission.title: identify Yes/No questions with can, may, and will from a text

interactions.prompt: Which sentence is a Yes/No question?
interactions.feedback: Yes! Can you swim? can be answered yes or no.
interactions.retryHint: Look for a question beginning with Can.

interactions.feedback: Correct! May I come in? is a Yes/No question.
interactions.retryHint: Find the sentence that starts with May and ends with a question mark.

interactions.prompt: Sort each sentence as a Yes/No question or not a Yes/No question.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a sentence, then tap its group.
interactions.feedback: Great sorting! Will and can begin the two Yes/No questions.
interactions.retryHint: Ask whether yes or no can fully answer each sentence.

interactions.prompt: Read: May we play outside? Yes, you may. Which part is the question?
interactions.feedback: Well spotted! The first sentence is the Yes/No question.
interactions.retryHint: Find the part ending with a question mark.

interactions.prompt: Match each question to its opening word.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a question, then tap its opening word.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! You identified can, may, and will questions.
interactions.retryHint: Read the first word in each question.

interactions.prompt: Which line contains three Yes/No questions?
choices: Can we go? May I sit? Will you help?
Where are we? May I sit? Who will help?
We can go. I may sit. You will help.
interactions.answer: Can we go? May I sit? Will you help?
interactions.feedback: Fantastic! All three can be answered yes or no.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the line with three question marks and the words can, may, and will.
